capabilities: Highlight code blocks in 31 languages using Tree-sitter grammars, including code inside code
Apply built-in, imported Helix, or exported Neovim themes to code blocks
Show #hex, rgb() and hsl() color codes on their own color
Flag security indicators, leaked secrets, and hidden characters in code and inline code
Open CVE, CWE, and MITRE ATT&CK reference pages from IDs in code
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); phone and tablet support planned, and Windows/Linux not yet tested. Plugin file is about 4 MB because all grammars are bundled. Code and README were generated with Claude under the author's direction; build checks are described in SECURITY.md. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's default code block highlighting is less accurate than Tree-sitter parsing and offers no color previews or warnings for leaked secrets and hidden characters.

relations.evidence: Highlight queries from nvim-treesitter (Apache License 2.0), with Treelights' own additions
Import a Helix theme (.toml), or export your Neovim color scheme
An optional pack adds LazyVim's highlighting extras for Lua and Markdown
export your Neovim color scheme with tools/export-nvim-theme.lua and load it as a theme file

summary: Tree-sitter-based syntax highlighting for code blocks in 31 languages, with themes, color previews, and warnings for secrets and hidden characters.
